summary: All 5 round-1 findings resolved. Re-enter guard AC and menu precedence are now explicitly mapped to existing tests in a 'Covered by existing tests' block (all cited method names verified to exist in the codebase: FunnelEventServiceTest.reEnter_duplicateOnOneFunnel_doesNotAbortOtherMatches, reEnter_allowReEnterFunnel_cancelsExistingThenInserts, ProcessTelegramUpdateJobTest.plainText_keywordSuppressedWhileWaitingForReply). Keyword-tap IT entry point is pinned to FunnelEventService.dispatchForSubscriber with the webhook leg explicitly delegated to ProcessTelegramUpdateJobTest.plainText_dispatchesKeyword (both in Testing Strategy and Task 6 — recommendation option from round 1, written down as required). CLEAR_KEYBOARD preview now covered on both sides: FunnelControllerIT asserts keyboardRows=null for CLEAR_KEYBOARD, FunnelMessagePreview.spec.ts names an explicit CLEAR_KEYBOARD render branch (text only, no rows mock); Decision 7 updated to state both types get preview coverage. FunnelStepForm.keyboard.spec.ts list extended with the 4096-cap mirror, a no-resize_keyboard-control assertion, and a CLEAR_KEYBOARD emit case (the emitted step structurally cannot carry resize_keyboard — the field does not exist on FunnelStep per Data Models — so the no-control assertion fully covers that AC). Bonus addition is sound: FunnelControllerIT PATCH→GET round-trip case directly backs the toStepDto-wiring tech-spec AC. No new gaps introduced: every user-spec AC maps to a named test or cited existing test; assertions described are behavioral (wire bodies via JsonNode, execution statuses, 422 codes, emitted step shapes, store-driven hint visibility) — no string-presence-only anchors; pyramid stays unit-heavy with slow-lane ITs and justified zero E2E. The dispatchForSubscriber keyword case in engine IT slightly overlaps FunnelEventServiceIT's generic keyword dispatch but adds feature-specific value (button-label text as the matched keyword within the keyboard flow) — not flagged.
